retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast classroom scene featuring a red apple with a lit fuse against a chalkboard filled with scattered, handwritten white chalk names.
excludeWhen: clean modern school imagery is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, moody classroom setting where a central red apple acts as a bomb with a lit, sparking fuse. The background is a heavily textured, smudged chalkboard covered in chaotic, white chalk handwriting. The foreground features a worn wooden desk with scattered school supplies like broken pencils, a ruler, and crumpled paper.
coreVisualRelationships: The bright sparkler light creates a central focal point against the dark slate.
The organic, vibrant red of the apple contrasts with the monochromatic, dusty chalkboard.
The scattered handwriting creates a radial energy around the central subject.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A medium-sized red apple is centered in the lower third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright, yellow-white spark at the tip of the fuse.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the spark, move down the fuse to the apple, then radiate outward to the handwritten names on the chalkboard.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, smudged areas of the chalkboard provide breathing room between the clusters of text.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (apple) and bright white (chalk text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm yellow and orange (sparkler light and wooden desk)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the white chalk and black board; high saturation on the central apple.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid clean, primary blues or greens
Stick to earthy, dusty, and high-contrast tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Varied handwriting styles ranging from blocky all-caps to fluid cursive
letterConstructionRules: Simulate the dry, crumbly texture of chalk on slate
Varying pressure and thickness to suggest multiple authors
Angled and scattered placement rather than a grid
characterSpecificRedesigns: Sharp, aggressive angles for rock-style names
Loopy, casual script for softer names
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A formal, high-contrast serif for the main title paired with chaotic, informal chalk handwriting for secondary elements.
graphicDevices: Horizontal rules underlining the main title
Smudge marks and chalk dust clouds

avoid: Perfectly clean digital fonts for the chalkboard

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Modern Serif (e.g., Bodoni or Times Bold)
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, authoritative look of the main title
To simulate the secondary handwritten names

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a dark, smudged chalkboard background with a wooden desk in the foreground. Place a red apple with a lit, sparking fuse in the center. Include scattered school items like a ruler and crumpled paper.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold red serif title at the top center. Surround the central apple with various names written in white chalk, using different handwriting styles and angles to fill the chalkboard space.

verificationChecks: Is the chalk texture realistic and dusty?
Does the red title contrast sharply with the dark board?
Is the sparkler light the brightest point in the image?
Are the handwritten names varied in style?

adjustableVariables: Density of names on the chalkboard
Amount of clutter on the desk
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or trademarked logos

avoid: Uniform, computer-generated fonts for the chalk

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the fuse spark looks like a long-exposure light trail.
Verify the apple has a realistic waxy sheen.
Check that the chalk text appears to sit 'on' the board texture.
Confirm the desk items look worn and used.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [textured background] + [central symbolic object with light source] + [scattered handwritten annotations] + [formal serif header].
